nrlmsise00.f107: previous UTC-day observed flux at actual Earth-Sun distance
nrlmsise00.f107_average: current UTC-day supplied observed centred 81-day average

jb2008.version: official SET 2008 core, official distribution README2023-05-24
jb2008.compiler: GNU Fortran -std=legacy fixed-form, binary64 C bridge
jb2008.latitude: geocentric in selected Earth-fixed equator basis
jb2008.height: WGS84 ellipsoidal project convention; official grid does not specify ellipsoid/datum
jb2008.sun_position: geometric SPICE Sun, same fixed equator basis as spacecraft; common angle zero cancels in H
jb2008.averages: supplied centred 81-day averages from each respective lagged record
jb2008.DSTDTC: official hourly DTCFILE, linear index interpolation then floor(value+0.5) K

time.utc: CSPICE LSK calendar, preserve seconds_of_day=86400 during leap second
time.quasi_mjd: 40587 + Gregorian days_since_1970 + seconds_of_day / actual UTC day length
time.leap_day_dtc: stretch final hourly interval only to 3601 s; input-index convention extension, never density interpolation

weather_policy.CSSI: v1.2 fixed-field archived observed section, Q=0 measured flux only; prediction/interpolation/missing fail
weather_policy.SOLFSMY: native per-proxy codes preserved; measured/derived/composite/corrected accepted, explicit gap/mean/neighbour fills rejected
weather_policy.DTCFILE: official archived storm correction; no per-record quality flags supplied, not invented

physical_models.drag: unchanged cold-beam Sentman force and torque
physical_models.srp: unchanged geometric conical eclipse SRP force and torque
physical_models.albedo: unchanged force and torque, Earth albedo 0.3
physical_models.spacecraft: unchanged CASE-A-v1, CASE-B-v1, CASE-C-v1 and legacy factory source hashes recorded in experiment manifest

propagation.refined_absolute_tolerances: same as nominal; explicit convergence limitation

benchmark.measurements: raw native per-call and batch distributions separate from direct provider acquisition and full propagation
benchmark.setup: excluded from model-call timing; measured separately

safety.nrlmsise00: process-wide mutex for mutable C state
safety.jb2008: conservative process-wide mutex, no COMMON drivers linked
safety.spice: existing process-wide mutex for all leo calls; external SPICE calls must be coordinated by application
